user_instruction: Make the visible eye opening a bit larger so its corners are closer to the shell corners, while preserving the exact eye-opening shape without deforming any corner or edge angle.
problem: V2 fits and covers the full shell opening, but the visible translucent eye opening can be enlarged while retaining its exact quadrilateral shape.

architecture.carrier: one opaque inward-tapered open-rear cassette wholly contained inside the eye opening
architecture.opening_cover_panel: one shallow integral face panel following the complete shell opening, including the missing region below the eye, with a 0.60 mm perimeter fit gap
architecture.lens: new 0.90 mm translucent lens behind a visible aperture made by uniform 0.88 similarity scaling about the pinned aperture center; all edge angles and corner relationships are unchanged
architecture.rear_led_plate: separate removable opaque plate installed from inside the head
architecture.head_attachment: thin black neutral-cure RTV seal at the 0.60 mm fitted perimeter; compact rear mounting flanges are the next serial stage
architecture.rear_plate_retention: three small neutral-cure RTV dabs for review geometry; serviceable mechanical retention remains a later physical coupon decision

former_lens_print_source_fcstd.role: read-only rejected-envelope provenance; geometry is not imported or reused

electronics.source_requirement: four densely spaced 5 V WS2812/SK6812-compatible pixels per eye
electronics.led_mount: flat adhesive landing on the removable rear plate
electronics.reflector: white reflective liner inside otherwise opaque black cassette
electronics.wire_exit: 4 mm rear hole; seal around cable and provide external strain relief
electronics.optical_note: 9.1 mm nominal lens-to-LED reference gap; physical hotspot coupon remains required

holds: No STL, 3MF, slicing, G-code, print recommendation, canonical mutation, mirroring, or promotion.
V2 remains preserved as the accepted fitted-panel basis but is superseded for visible-aperture size.
Mounting flanges are intentionally deferred until this fitted front panel receives visual LGTM.
